definition: מַטְמוֺן noun masculine hidden treasure, treasure ; — absolute מַטְמוֺן Gen 43:23 plural מַטְמֹנִים Jer 41:8 ; Prov 2:4 מַטְמוֺנִים Job 3:21 construct מַטְמֻנֵי Isa 45:3 ( hidden ) treasure Gen 43:23 (of money in sacks); מַטְמֻנֵי מִסְתָּרים Isa 45:3 (i.e. treasures now hidden in secret places, shall become spoil of Cyrus; || אוצרות חשׁך ), Jer 41:8 , appositive חִפִּים שְׁעֹרִים שֶׁמֶן דבשׁ ; in comparative Job 3:21 (longing for death more than for treasure), Prov 2:4 (wisdom sought for like treasure).
